title: What I Wish I Knew Applying to College
description: Divulging my main college admissions tips so you don't figure them out the hard way, from general mindsets to section specific pointers I wish I knew.

title: College App tracking templates and tools
description: One of the biggest lessons I learned was you don'tneed to bust money on fancy softwares or planners when Google calendar and sheets exist. I learned a bit of spreadsheet tricks and am quite proud of how it turned out.

title: Why Delulu
description: A central piece of U Delulu lore of how I came to love colleges in the first place. And a conjecture that college admissions is isomorphic to love

title: Tech Dinghies
description: Tech dinghies! I found a whole manual about them on the MIT sailing page. This is under-rendered compared to my other works but sailboats are officially my new favorite thing to draw. Please let me get into the sailing class!!!

title: Reading on the steps
description: An idyllic scene fit for a college brochure. Been trying to work on my fundamentals and not use heavy rendering as a clutch. I quite like the lighting. Frosh has found eternal peace.

title: Reading on the quad
description: A more ambitious composition of a quintessential college scene. Reading on the quad with a bike and a frisbee? How much more collegiate does it get?

title: Frisbee on the quad
description: I am bad at playing frisbee but I discovered that I am worse at drawing frisbee players.

title: What I would tell my High School Self
description: The mindsets I learned throughout high school that helped me perpare for college applications. Yes, there are stories behind each section that I might expand upon later. But this is the TLDR of my takeaways from high school.

title: A Problem of Scale
description: My process of organizing and updating the Deluluversity to support scaling content. Even though the Deluluversity is infrastructure for my creative pursuits, I have not yet figured out the of scaling my life to do everything I love which is a very sad problem.

title: Tim's Internship
description: Drawing Tim the Beaver was one of MIT's orientation games. I imagined Tim enjoying the communte to his internship at his dream company! It felt so refreshing to get back into art.

title: The Harvard Variations
description: This was the last piece I wrote for a contest before I quit. I decided not to submit it. I was venting about why I love prestige so much after losing a debate tournament. I knew I was only this desperate because I wanted the life in the stock photos.

title: Is Attention All You Need?
description: I love attention (attenton mechanisms too but mostly attention from other people). But am I only delulu for attention or do I genuinely pay attention to the delulu?

title: Floating my Boat
description: How I came to be obsessed with boats... and it's more than a phase because delulu comes true on the Charles River. I think boats are beautiful and that is an axiom that doesn't require justification. But how far am I willing to go?

title: A Map fom my Future
description: One of my favorite memories. Fifteen minutes at the welcome center slash admissions office, a map, and proof that kindness is truly beautiful.

title: Paper Planes
description: My gold-medal flash fiction piece that immortalized an embarrassing typo. It was the peak of my writing career, but how did I let that fly by?

title: Barker Sailing
description: I was super excited for sailing at CPW so I painted Barker in a dinghy!

title: Barker's art class
description: Barker loved modeling at the mini canvas painting at CPW! My classmates did an amazing job capturing his physique.

title: Deluluversity Renovations Part 1: Update Automations
description: I added a script to automate website updates which was pretty good Python practice. Instead of writing and copying HTML format, I edit a JSON and the Python script translates that into HTML format and updates the pages.
